summary:
Fixed the agentic search-context delivery clip. Commit 00806352 on orch/attempt/claude-on-arm-grader-retrieval-production-identical-via-subconscious-search-context (2 files, +67/-1).

ROOT CAUSE: context delivered to the answerer was clipped to the 200-char display summary BEFORE reaching context_deps. memory-search.js sets result.summary=slice(0,200); subconscious/index.js rankResults runs every result through compactResult (drops unlisted fields, reclips 240); contextDependencyFromResult emits summary.slice(0,240) (no-op). Source chunks store the full answer text in node.summary (CHUNK_CHARS=1200), so 200 chars truncated the GPS answer.

FIX (token-aware, agentic-path ONLY): (1) lib/subconscious/index.js searchUrlForPlan adds full_content=1 — only subconscious agentic paths build that URL; one-shot GET /search never sets it. (2) lib/search/context-compiler.js compileSearchContext, on full_content, attaches a bounded `content` (<=1200, source-chunk granularity) from the live node text; the 200-char display summary is untouched. (3) compactResult preserves `content` (bounded). (4) contextDependencyFromResult emits `content` as the delivered summary when present, else the prior 240 clip. Budget 1200 chosen to match CHUNK_CHARS so a matched chunk arrives whole; item count already bounded (<=5 context_deps) => worst case ~5x1200 chars.

BEFORE/AFTER EVIDENCE (direct HTTP repro against the WORKTREE daemon, head 00806352, with my fix): POST /subconscious/search-context for the GPS query returned context_deps with summary_len=1200 and the GPS answer text PRESENT (hasGPS=true) on the top chunks — vs the old 200-char clip. Negative control on the SAME daemon: GET /search stayed at summary_len=200 with content_present=false, proving general consumers are unaffected. arms.py run_retrieve_and_answer (agentic branch) builds the answerer context from context_deps[].summary, which now carries the whole chunk.

BENCH CAVEAT (honest): the full our-way-prod bench could NOT complete
